kind: code (tier A) — created early to carry a Phase-1 gate binding; full assertion rows authored when Phase 9 is reached.

MUST: findingSurvives(verdicts, k) counts k = skepticsPerFinding as the denominator, so a MISSING verdict (a skeptic that timed out via subSessionTimeoutMs) counts as an overturn. The item-review handler MUST NOT feed an under-delivered panel straight to findingSurvives: on fewer than k returned verdicts it must either re-dispatch the missing skeptics, or count the missing ones as UPHOLDS (conservative — keep the finding). A real major must never be dropped because a skeptic session crashed.
